data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘mitra’, meaning ‘friend’. In Hindu mythology, Mitra is a deity associated with friendship, treaties, and contracts. historical_references.reference: The Mahabharata mentions a sage named Mitun in the context of the Kurukshetra war. He was a revered sage and a devoted devotee of Lord Shiva. He had the power to create an illusion of himself, which he used to protect the Pandava army from the Kaurava army during the war.

Mitun, also known as Mithuna or Jupiter, is one of the Navagrahas (nine planets) in Hindu astrology. According to the Puranas, Mitun was the son of Surya, the sun god, and his wife Sanjana. He is considered to be the planet of growth, expansion, and abundance.
